study type: Qualitative exploratory study (focus group discussions and nonparticipating observation)
exposure: Objective factors (fetal distress, non-progressive labor, macrosomia)
Activities outside the individual delivery room
outcome: Decision to advise/propose cesarean section during labor
cohort: The study participants were midwives and gynecologists working in an obstetric ward.
finding: Intuition plays an important and variable role, often increasing with experience, in maternity care workers' decisions to advise a cesarean section during labor, alongside objective factors.
cross-section timing: During labor and decision-making process for cesarean section
